logline: In Milwaukee, a younger brother living in the shadow of his feared older brother begins to awaken through a mysterious woman, family duty, and loss—until years later he must decide whether forgiveness can free him from the past.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Dad leaves when narrator is about eight; brothers and Ma live in fifth-floor walk-up on Kirk Street, Milwaukee; Nick protects narrator and takes blame for broken window.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: I lived with him and Ma after dad took off when I was about eight. We lived downtown in a big brick apartment building on Kirk Street.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Narrator works pizza job, cares for aging Ma; Nick works metal factory, drives 1980 Trans Am, dominates bars and gym.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: Nick has a job down at the local metal factory... He has a nice car and a pretty cool apartment down on Werner Street.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Girl trips into narrator outside pizza place; name Sionna; coffee at Java Hut; Wuthering Heights; dreams of past-life forest kiss.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: She kind of fell into me... “Sionna” she said.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Ma confused, high blood pressure, brief hospital stay; narrator and Sionna organize meds; fight with Nick escalates.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: Your mother’s blood pressure is dangerously high... take her directly to the emergency room

source_grounded_timeline.events: At Joe’s, Nick confronts Lindsey’s new boyfriend; narrator intervenes; Nick nearly hits him; narrator runs to Sionna.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: I stepped up closer than I had ever dared to face Nick when he was in a state of rage.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Nick, possibly drunk after church, crashes; Ma dies at scene; Nick seriously injured; toxicology pending.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: your brother is in serious condition at Frodo and your mother passed away at the scene.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Nick blames Sionna, confronts her at duplex with switchblade; narrator arrives; Sionna is stabbed; Nick flees.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: The knife hits her hard and there is red flying out.

source_grounded_timeline.events: Sionna leaves after recovery; narrator builds pizza chain in Seattle; returns to forgive imprisoned Nick; name revealed as Peter Olson.
source_grounded_timeline.source_evidence: I own a pizza chain in Seattle... “That’s me. President Peter Olson.”

withheld_name_rules.narrator_given_name: Withhold on-screen and in dialogue until final beat; source reveals only at end as Peter Olson.
withheld_name_rules.policy: Use CHAR_NARRATOR / 'little brother' / 'Bro' until final title card or V.O. line matching source close.
withheld_name_rules.source_evidence: I whispered to myself, “That’s me. President Peter Olson.”

essential_beats.description: Establish Nick as feared modern Viking protector and narrator as caretaker of Ma on Kirk Street.
essential_beats.source_evidence: Nick was the guy everybody was scared of... I lived with him and Ma

essential_beats.description: Chance collision outside pizza place; Sionna’s eyes and fish necklace; coffee invitation.
essential_beats.source_evidence: this girl tripped over the cement... She had on a necklace with some kind of fish symbol

essential_beats.description: Library, Wuthering Heights, yoga, meditation; narrator feels himself becoming a person apart from Nick.
essential_beats.source_evidence: Something inside of me was coming awake... I started to feel like a real person.

essential_beats.description: Missed doctor appointment; Nick rage; later Joe’s almost-punch; narrator chooses Sionna’s arms.
essential_beats.source_evidence: Your brother tried to hit you.

essential_beats.description: Police messages; Ma dead at scene; Nick blamed; narrator’s grief and hatred.
essential_beats.source_evidence: your mother passed away at the scene... And Nick killed her.

essential_beats.description: Nick attacks Sionna; stabbing; narrator applies pressure; sirens.
essential_beats.source_evidence: I found myself suddenly awake again, back up against the wall, trying to support her body weight

essential_beats.description: Years later Seattle to Green Bay prison visit; narrator forgives Nick and reclaims self; name sealed.
essential_beats.source_evidence: I forgive you, Nick, because it also releases your control over me forever

scene_outline.purpose: Open on family gravity: Ma fragile, Nick dominant, narrator trapped in duty.
scene_outline.source_evidence: Someone has to be here with Ma. She’s getting older and it’s hard for her to see.

scene_outline.purpose: Meet Sionna; first spark of other life.
scene_outline.source_evidence: just as I was walking down the sidewalk and into the front door of the pizza place, this girl tripped

scene_outline.purpose: Conversation awakens mind; book talk; second date set.
scene_outline.source_evidence: We decided to meet downtown at a coffee shop called The Java Hut.

scene_outline.purpose: Ma confusion; Nick blames narrator; internal hate under loyalty.
scene_outline.source_evidence: I knew she would start going crazy cooped up in that place all day

scene_outline.purpose: Public fracture; Nick almost strikes narrator; flight to Sionna.
scene_outline.source_evidence: his right fist slowly drawing back and moving toward my face

scene_outline.purpose: Accident revealed; Ma dead; Nick critical.
scene_outline.source_evidence: your mother passed away at the scene

scene_outline.purpose: Nick’s knife attack; narrator intervenes; blood.
scene_outline.source_evidence: Holy shit, Nick, what the fuck are you doing?

scene_outline.purpose: Years later; successful but haunted; decision to return.
scene_outline.source_evidence: I now had my own chain of pizzerias here in the Northwest.
I forgive you. I forgive you for being a huge asshole because it sets me free.
